answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 11 epochs old, anchored at a comet checkpoint. The voyage chain is verified at intake and raven publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 11 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The attacker spends 179 dollars and 15 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
